blocks.text: [ Principle 01 ]
Principle 1: Introducing Myself
Greeting and Introduction
Nice to meet you.
First of all, thank you for giving me a chance to introduce myself.
My name is 박수민, but you can call me (Mrs. 박).
My Personal and Educational Background
I was born in 부산, but now I live in 서울.
I live at the 한국 Apartments with my husband and 2 children.
I graduated from 한국 Women’s High School in 1990 in 서울.
When I was in high school, I enjoyed studying English every day.
I studied (English) at 한국 University.
I’m 39 years old.
My Personality
I’m An Outgoing Person
Even though I’m a very outgoing person, I’m sometimes a little shy around new people.
I have a lot of friends who(m) I love to be around with.
I’m a pretty happy person, so most people like me.
I’m A Shy Person
I’m kind of a shy person.
I am afraid I talk too much, but everyone says I am a very likeable person and fun to be around.
I’m a pretty happy person. Most people like me after they get to know me.
My Hobbies
My hobbies include reading books, listening to music, hiking, watching movies and playing and watching sports, but I especially like hiking.
